jobs.occupation: PLC Software and Commissioning Engineer/Technician (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Automatisierungstechnik)

jobs.description:
YOU ACT

As a Level 1 PLC Software Developer in a strong team, you help shape the logistics of tomorrow and develop intelligent software to control complex intralogistics processes in the metal industry and port logistics. Your responsibilities also include:

- High-tech meets heavy loads: Control and monitor large systems such as cranes, conveyor technology, and vehicles that move loads of up to 50 tons—precisely, efficiently, and in real time.
- From creating solutions to commissioning: Design interfaces, collaborate closely with customers, and support projects worldwide—from the first alignment to onsite final acceptance test.
- International & communicative: Work on global projects with English in your day-to-day work and experience exciting customer locations around the globe.
- Virtual worlds & smart testing: Develop and test software with digital twins, simulators, and visualizations—everything within a powerful in-house testing environment.
- Stable environment with a strong team: Benefit from an excellent team spirit, long-term employee retention, and minimal turnover—you’ll enjoy staying here for the long term.

YOU KNOW

You have a completed degree in electrical engineering, automation technology or a comparable field of study or job experience and further training as technician.
We also value:

- Preferably experience in S7-TIA software development
- Analytical skills regarding technical processes and interrelationships, and the ability to translate them into automation solutions
- Good English language skills and a strong interest in working in a team

You are also welcome to apply if you are an ambitious early-career professional.

WE CONVINCE

As an innovative, medium-sized and internationally active employer, we offer you a challenging role with plenty of scope for initiative and creativity.

You can expect a team-oriented working environment that provides opportunities to contribute, flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes. In addition, we support your professional and personal development through targeted personnel development measures.

We also offer flexible working time models and attractive additional benefits.

Have we convinced you to help shape the future with us? If so, we look forward to receiving your online application. We would also be pleased to answer any questions you may have in advance.

jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität Dresden
jobs.description:
TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in the country. Founded in 1828, today it is a globally oriented, regionally anchored top university as it focuses on the grand challenges of the 21st century. It develops innovative solutions for the world's most pressing issues. In research and academic programs, the university unites the natural and engineering sciences with the humanities, social sciences and medicine. This wide range of disciplines is a special feature, facilitating interdisciplinarity and transfer of science to society. As a modern employer, it offers attractive working conditions to all employees in teaching, research, technology and administration. The goal is to promote and develop their individual abilities while empowering everyone to reach their full potential. TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution. At the Faculty of Computer Science, Institute of Computer Engineering, the Chair of Adaptive Dynamic Systems offers a full-time position as

Research Associate / PhD Student (m/f/x)
in Near-Memory Computing for RISC-V
(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)

starting as soon as poosible. The position is limited to 2 years, with the option of extension. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position aims at obtaining further academic qualification.

The Chair of Adaptive Dynamic Systems conducts research in the fields of reconfigurable computing, domain-specific computer architectures, networks-on-chip (NoCs), methods and algorithms for application parallelization, simulators and virtual platforms for application- and architecture exploration, hardware/software co-design and operating/runtime systems. Typical application domains are e.g. signal-/image processing and machine learning

Tasks:

modeling and simulation of near-memory computing architectures for RISC-V processors using SystemC and field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs)
developing machine learning methods to identify suitable computational kernels and optimize their placement within the processor memory hierarchy
contributing, administrating and reporting in (inter-)national research and development projects
publishing and presenting results at international conferences
close cooperation with academic and industrial cooperation partners

excellent university degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering or a related field
very good programming skills in C/C++
fluency in English; knowledge of German is an advantage
high self-motivation, commitment, and flexibility, as well as the ability to work effectively in an international team
strong background in one or more of the following areas: computer architecture, RISC-V, FPGA-based systems, SystemC, VHDL or Verilog, high-level synthesis, compiler frameworks, artificial intelligence, and/or machine learning
an excellent working environment in an international team with many career development possibilities.

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Join the dynamic Internal Consulting team at Boehringer Ingelheim! We're looking for innovative thinkers who are ready to shape our company's future.
As a Manager Consulting, you'll design, execute, and steer strategic initiatives within Boehringer Ingelheim. You'll independently coordinate project tasks, run data analyses, develop hypotheses and strategize solutions.
We value work-life balance, offering flexible work models and a location at the Headquarters in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main area.
This position is part time eligible with min. 80%.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As Manager Consulting, you will support in the design, execution and steering of strategic initiatives across businesses, functions, therapeutic areas, and regions within Boehringer Ingelheim.
- You will independently drive work packages within projects, generating strategic insights to enable informed decisions of top-level leaders.
- With your experience, you will run data analyses, develop hypotheses, find possible strategic paths and create actionable solutions to advance the organization.
- Having the successful outcome always in mind, you will track the progress and strategic alignment of projects and initiatives, in close collaboration with our business partners.

Requirements

- Excellent master's degree in sciences, economics or engineering (PhD or MBA a plus)
- Several years' experience with top-tier management consultancy, preferably with a focus on Pharma
- Track record of working on diverse national and international strategic projects
- Excellent critical thinking and analytical skills, with high attention to detail
- Great team player, with strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills
- C1 level English (written and verbal); additional languages are a plus

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

KG, you will work in a high-tech environment where advanced products are created from silicon wafers. In our modern cleanroom environment, every detail matters. With your expertise, you will help shape the future by driving innovation every step of the way.

Your role

- Monitoring, controlling, and initiating manufacturing processes using SPC (Statistical Process Control) methods and process parameters.- Performing regular cleaning and setup activities on equipment components, including the documentation of all completed work.- Identifying faults in machines and systems, including taking responsibility for complex repair and maintenance tasks that may not be fully documented.- Inspecting, servicing, and maintaining production equipment, as well as documenting all related activities.- Providing on-the-job training and instruction for new employees.- Coordinating workflows and material flow in a multi-shift operation under cleanroom conditions.- Setting up machines, loading and monitoring equipment, and actively supporting production operations.

This position is to be filled within a four-shift working model.
Several Senior Technologist (f/m/div) positions are available in the DIF, MET, and PPI departments.

jobs.occupation: 176/2026 Junior Group Leader (m/f/d) in Computational Multiphase Flow (Ingenieur/in - Verfahrenstechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Otto-von-Guericke- Universität Magdeburg
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Process and Systems Engineering, Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering seeks to fill the following vacancy:

Junior Group Leader (m/f/d) in Computational Multiphase Flow

Salary scale:
13 TV-L

Date commencing:
As soon as possible

Fixed term:
3 years*

Contract status:
100 %

At the Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering (www.mvt.ovgu.de), we are a group of enthusiastic researchers with extensive research activities in the numerical modelling of multiphase flows. Our work addresses the fundamental physical mechanisms governing dispersed and interfacial multiphase flows, as well as their application to engineering systems. Current research topics include particle-laden and droplet-laden turbulent flows, particle–turbulence and droplet–turbulence interactions, the dynamics of non-spherical particles, interfacial flows, and compressible and incompressible multiphase-flow applications. Approximately eight PhD researchers and three postdoctoral researchers currently work in this area at the Chair.

The objective of the advertised position is to attract a junior group leader who will take a leading role in our computational multiphase-flow research. The successful candidate will contribute to and help coordinate ongoing research projects, while also establishing their own research direction within the Chair. The position offers excellent opportunities to develop an independent academic profile and to pursue a Habilitation. It therefore combines scientific leadership in existing activities with the opportunity to initiate new research topics and contribute to the further development of our numerical methods and simulation tools.

Our in-house simulation framework includes state-of-the-art methods for immersed boundaries, Lagrangian particle and droplet tracking, non-spherical particle dynamics, particle and droplet interactions, gas–liquid interfaces, large-eddy simulation, and fully coupled solvers for compressible and incompressible flows. You will also have the opportunity to establish your own teaching portfolio in areas such as numerical methods, multiphase flows, or particle technology.

*The position is full time for a period of 3 years with the opportunity to extend by a further 3 years.

Job description:

- Develop, implement, and analyse analytical and numerical models for multiphase flows
- Establish an independent research profile in computational multiphase-flow modelling
- Lead and coordinate the further development of our in-house simulation tools in C and MPI
- Develop research ideas and prepare proposals for externally funded research projects
- Supervise PhD researchers, postdoctoral researchers, and students working in computational multiphase flows
- Contribute to teaching in multiphase flows, numerical methods, particle technology, or related subjects
- Contribute to the scientific development and coordination of the computational multiphase-flow group
- Opportunity for further scientific qualification, including the possibility to pursue a Habilitation

Requirements profile:

- A Master’s degree or equivalent and a PhD in mechanical engineering, process engineering, aerospace engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or a related discipline
- A strong background in the physical and numerical modelling of fluid-mechanical or multiphase-flow problems
- Demonstrated research experience in computational multiphase flows, such as particle-laden, droplet-laden, or interfacial flows
- Strong scientific-programming skills in C, C++, or Fortran, including experience with MPI and high-performance computing
- Experience in developing numerical methods or simulation software; expertise in techniques such as immersed-boundary methods, Lagrangian tracking, interface-capturing methods, or particle-interaction models is desirable
- A strong publication record commensurate with your career stage, together with the ability to develop independent research ideas and contribute to research proposals
- Excellent written and spoken English, as well as a good command of German or a commitment to acquiring sufficient German proficiency for teaching and administrative duties within two years

For further information about the position, please contact Prof. Berend van Wachem by email, berend.vanwachem(at)ovgu.de

You will benefit from our structures and offerings in the fields of sustainability, diversity, family support and staff development. Our location in the center of a thriving, lively and family-friendly state capital guarantees a high quality of life and a wide range of leisure activities. For more information, please visit www.ovgu.de/en/karriere (http://www.ovgu.de/en/karriere) .

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- You will design, develop, and enhance scalable data products and pipelines based on SAP and non-SAP data sources and build data models in Snowflake, ensuring the availability and quality of strategically critical data assets in Finance.
- Build transformation logic and analytics layers using dbt, including modular data modeling, testing, documentation, and deployment best practices.
- Act as a role model for engineering excellence: version control, CI/CD, code reviews, documentation, and mentoring Data Engineers.
- In regard to technology evaluation you will stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to continuously improve data engineering practices.

Requirements

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and several years of professional experience as a Data Engineer, Software Developer, Data Scientist or in a similar role (or Bachelor's degree with more relevant professional experience).
- Proven proficiency with the Apache ecosystem (Iceberg, Spark, Airflow).
- Strong experience with AWS cloud services (Glue, Lambda, StepFunctions) and Python scripting language.
- Solid hands-on experience with Snowflake and dbt including data modeling, performance tuning, and secure data access patterns.
- Experience with SAP's modern cloud data landscape and/or SAP BW data modelling is considered a strong advantage.
- Familiarity with end-to-end Finance processes (e.g. SAP FI/CO), including period-end closing, financial reporting and planning & consolidation processes.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage priorities, and proactively drive work forward together with our stakeholders in a dynamic environment.
- Excellent communication skills in English (German is a strong plus), enabling clear interaction with technical and non technical stakeholders.

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
